content.title: BYD ATTO 3 EVO | Electric SUV with 510km Range | BYD EU
content.text: How far can I travel in the BYD ATTO 3 EVO before charging? The BYD ATTO 3 EVO has a WLTP combined range of up to 510km, meaning you can travel approximately 310 miles before needing to plug in to charge. This can differ depending on driving conditions, weather and terrain. What comfort features does the BYD ATTO 3 EVO have? The BYD ATTO 3 EVO has plenty of leg space in the rear with a flat floor that means everyone can get comfortable on the go. You can also use this space for additional cargo and still have room to spare. The rear seats are also heated to keep passengers warm on cold days, and with flexible pockets for cups and snacks, you can travel with everything you need for a long journey. Multi-coloured ambient lighting lets you set the mood inside the cabin. How much boot space does the BYD ATTO 3 EVO have? Storage in the BYD ATTO 3 EVO is flexible, with a 101-litre front trunk that is perfect for storing charging cables and small bags. The main rear trunk offers 490 litres of space — enough for two large suitcases and several smaller bags. There is also a hidden space beneath the boot floor to keep possessions safe and secure. Is the BYD ATTO 3 EVO safe? Yes. The BYD ATTO 3 EVO features the ultra-safe Blade Battery, which has undergone a range of rigorous tests for added peace of mind. It is designed to be extremely strong and is considered one of the safest EV batteries on the market. The vehicle also includes a wide range of innovative driver safety systems. What makes BYD ATTO 3 EVO different from the standard ATTO 3? The BYD ATTO 3 EVO is built on the latest 800V e-Platform 3.0 and delivers higher performance and faster charging. It offers up to 330kW of power, all-wheel drive, acceleration from 0–100 km/h in 3.9 seconds, and up to 220kW DC fast charging capability. How long does it take to charge BYD ATTO 3 EVO? With DC fast charging, the ATTO 3 EVO can recharge from 10% to 80% in just 25 minutes. For home charging, it also supports an optional 11kW wallbox. How does BYD ATTO 3 EVO perform in cold weather? A high-efficiency heat-pump system comes as standard. It reduces energy consumption for heating and cooling, helping to preserve driving range in low temperatures.
